name: Factual trust cues
rule: Earn trust with specific, checkable facts and controls the user can use, not decorative badges or vague reassurance.

leaders.note: Names the exact audit level, the encryption standard and the reports available on request. It also lists user controls: passkey MFA, roles, audit logs and new-device alerts.
Explains how customer money is kept separate and which regulator oversees it. It lists certifications and gives users controls: two-step login, card freeze and spend alerts.
Describes specific permissions, usage indicators, a seven-day app access report and opt-in analytics. It shows what is collected and puts the user in control, with no seals.
